note: Keyed area, point of interest or key space. Prose flows to the next heading; AX2's icon runs become section labels; 'Name:' quick-stat lines emit creature lookups. A keyed place anchors by its key NUMBER (as runin if run-in) and ships no word of its name; meta.space names its key space, meta.parent its parent, meta.sameAs + meta.unique a later book's place. Binds to a place actor or journal page.
